# Bid the rail, the chair, and the extras.

> Price a stair lift from lift count, straight versus landing versus outdoor versus curved rail, perch versus standard versus power-swivel versus power-pack versus heavy-duty chair, wood versus concrete versus open-riser attach, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $3,995 installed special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
